records.rule: If generation intent or information-use lineage matters, capture it before flattening; post-hoc transcript analysis cannot reliably reconstruct it.
Declared generation intent/use is evidence, not authority; structural effective use can disagree and the mismatch must survive.
Privacy follows semantic lineage, not literal strings; removing customer prose does not erase customer-derived provenance.
Interaction Event native evidence objects are authority for downstream evidence reasoning; compatibility tags are routing aids only.
Model assessments remain assessments and may disagree; do not rewrite them into facts.
Association is not causation at every layer, including randomized study-design provenance.
The denominator, time scope, outcome window, classifier/taxonomy and counterevidence travel with aggregate claims.
Count sufficiency, effect magnitude, confidence and cohort quality are independent gates.
CONVENIENCE or a narrow sample is evidence about sampling; it is not automatically a moral judgement or bias verdict.
Customers experience one organisation across departments; Brand Journey preserves context loss/recovery without becoming CRM.
Recovery does not erase the earlier failure; both remain evidence.
Promotional/reputational/commercial relationship work does not imply SALESPROP, upsell mandate or sales authority.
A cohort-quality failure requests evidence repair, not tone/behaviour change.
A material point estimate with overlapping default Wilson intervals is NO_CLEAR_ASSOCIATION, not PROMISING_ASSOCIATION.
Primary and guardrail outcomes stay separate; do not collapse brand outcomes into one scalar utility score.
Institutional Policy selects the operative reviewed rule artefact; Brand Governance owns domain semantics but not publication/deployment authority.
Guidance, effectiveness evidence and governance dispositions are non-executing; an external action component owns execution.
A newer roll-up or filename is not proof of compositional compatibility; execute the real chain and preserve failures as evidence.
Journey Population v0.3 gives upstream source/sampling/dedup ownership to the population and local selection/outcome ownership to the cohort definition.
Brand Intervention v0.2 is not fully green against Journey Population v0.3 until its old population.configureProvenance setup is rebased or compatibly adapted.
